sentences.en: No, I'm not suffering from asthma. I'm moaning in lust!
sentences.zh: 不，我不是哮喘发作。我在享受欲望。

sentences.en: My daughter, as a child, often suffered from asthma attacks.
sentences.zh: 我女儿小时候经常哮喘发作。

sentences.en: Have you ever been intubated because of an asthma attack?
sentences.zh: 你因为哮喘发作曾经被插管治疗过吗？
